title: Investment Growth Rate
scenario: Calculate the growth rate from 'tiv_2015' to 'tiv_2016' for each policyholder. Return the 'pid' and 'growth_rate', where 'growth_rate' is ((tiv_2016 - tiv_2015) / tiv_2015) * 100.
tableSchema: insurance (pid INT, tiv_2015 DECIMAL, tiv_2016 DECIMAL, lat DECIMAL, lon DECIMAL)
hint: Handle potential division by zero if tiv_2015 is zero.
correctQuery: SELECT pid, ((tiv_2016 - tiv_2015) * 100.0 / NULLIF(tiv_2015, 0)) AS growth_rate FROM insurance;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE insurance (pid INT, tiv_2015 DECIMAL, tiv_2016 DECIMAL, lat DECIMAL, lon DECIMAL); INSERT INTO insurance VALUES (1, 100, 120, 10, 10), (2, 200, 180, 20, 20);
